name: Create Stripe Webhook Endpoint
description: Creates a Stripe webhook endpoint. Handles form-encoding of enabled events, metadata, and expand parameters that Stripe's API requires.

url.description: The URL the webhook will POST events to

enabledEvents.description: List of event types to subscribe to (e.g., ['charge.succeeded', 'invoice.paid']). Use ['*'] for all events.

description.description: Human-readable description for this webhook endpoint

connect.description: Whether to receive events from connected accounts (Stripe Connect)

metadata.description: Key-value metadata to attach to the webhook endpoint

steps.name: Build form-encoded data for Stripe's webhook API
Create the webhook endpoint via Stripe API
Format the response with webhook secret
